name: Tetrapoda
blurb: Four-limbed vertebrates and their descendants, including those that later lost their limbs, such as snakes and caecilians.

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (PhyloBayes, CAT-GTR), calibration scheme C16; mean and conservative 95% credibility interval (extremes of the 95% CIs of 100 gene-jackknife timetrees)
clock.checked: Irisarri et al. 2017, Supplementary Table 9, node 105 ("Tetrapods")
